Package com.github.gumtreediff.gen.jdt.cd

Class CdJdtVisitor

java.lang.Object
org.eclipse.jdt.core.dom.ASTVisitor
com.github.gumtreediff.gen.jdt.AbstractJdtVisitor
com.github.gumtreediff.gen.jdt.cd.CdJdtVisitor
public class CdJdtVisitor extends AbstractJdtVisitor
Combination of two ChangeDistiller's AST visitors: JavaASTBodyTransformer and JavaASTChangeDistillerVisitor. Modifications are labeled as "@Inria" INRIA removed fNodeStack since it's inherited with the new
